gates.ENGINEERING: Deterministic code/test/CI evidence. AI-actionable end to end.
gates.PRODUCT_QUALITY: Measured accessibility, responsiveness, performance, real-browser journeys. AI-actionable.
gates.PRODUCTION: Artifact SHA, deployment, smoke and rollback evidence that AI can produce with existing access.
gates.CLINICAL_SAFETY_ENG: Engineering safety of clinical functions. Never equals clinical validation.

criteria.capability: Every required workflow on main is green at the exact main head.
criteria.risk: A red main hides regressions and makes every PR's CI evidence meaningless.
criteria.done: Latest run of each required workflow on the current main SHA has conclusion success.
criteria.negativeControl: A deliberately failing required job on a throwaway branch must turn the check red.
criteria.evidence: Run IDs per required workflow for the exact main SHA, recorded in docs/governance/TASK_BOARD.md.
criteria.statusNote: Stabilization, Body 3D, User Journey (F1), Dependency Audit and Production browser check failed on 256a22de.

criteria.capability: Browser jobs run on a runner image the pinned Playwright supports.
criteria.risk: ubuntu-latest moved to 26.04; Playwright 1.55 cannot install Chromium there, so every browser gate fails before testing.
criteria.done: Every workflow job that installs Playwright pins a supported runs-on image; browser jobs reach their test steps.
criteria.negativeControl: Same job on ubuntu-latest (26.04) fails at 'Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64'.
criteria.evidence: Exact-head run of each browser workflow reaching its test step.

criteria.negativeControl: scripts/qa/dependency-audit-gate.test.mjs fixtures with unaccepted highs must fail.
